name: Bloodmage: learning Running Wild also teaches Running Wild (Journeyman) (#4468)
contract: #4468 Running Wild 800175 (+60% speed, family 26 mask0 0x20000000) is a Bloodmage class spell at level 20 in AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells, which mod-spellbook's BuildRows offers and SynchronizeProgression reconciles by level. Class spells are not auto-learned while CoA.AutoProgression = 0. Running Wild (Journeyman) 520575 (hidden passive Add Flat Modifier +40 on SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, same mask) is not sold; it is learned together with Running Wild and removed with it. Expected: level 20 alone teaches neither; the book offers Running Wild but not 520575; buying Running Wild teaches both; Running Wild's amount is then 100 and the run speed rate is doubled; 520575 shares the mask with Pooled Vitality 680687, whose effect 0 is a 0-value Rage energize, so the raw data also gives it +40 (4 Rage), which is kept; dropping below level 20 removes both.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
fixture: a purse for the ability the book sells
learn the book companion spell
summon the book
the book is out
level 20 alone does not teach Running Wild (Journeyman)
open the book
the book answered with a trainer window
the book offers Running Wild
the book does not sell Running Wild (Journeyman)
buy Running Wild
the purchase was granted
Running Wild was learned
learning Running Wild also taught Running Wild (Journeyman)
let the global cooldown the book shares with Running Wild run out
run wild
Running Wild is active
Running Wild (Journeyman) raises it to a 100% increase
the run speed rate is doubled
the shared family mask also gives Pooled Vitality +40 (4 Rage), as in the raw data
stand up
dropping to level 19 removes Running Wild
dropping to level 19 removes Running Wild (Journeyman)
